name: taskplane
description: AI software-delivery control plane for Claude and Codex: stateless stage handoffs, scoped execution, focused pre-build review, direct Evaluate and Engineering evidence, durable recovery, and human approval.

interface.longDescription: taskplane connects requirements, Design, Plan, Build, Evaluate, Engineering, and Retro through scoped contracts and fingerprinted evidence. Fresh invocations recover exact run-owned settings and approved artifacts. Product and Design use focused review routes; Plan uses three or four selected lenses; Build, Evaluate, and Engineering launch no lens workers. Workers submit evidence, orchestrator-only gates validate it, and humans retain scope and final sign-off authority. Native lifecycle observations and measured or explicitly unknown usage remain distinct from source-test results.
capabilities: Enforce Definition of Ready before implementation begins
Approve a proposed-HOW Design Contract before complex implementation
Carry dependency overlays, named contracts, and graph DoR/DoD from Design into Build and Review
Constrain execution to an approved task scope
Require evidence-backed Definition of Done before sign-off
Gate dependency and contract impact at Ready and Done
Separate worker submissions from orchestrator validation
Review code and solution designs through 26 engineering lenses
Publish progress artifacts for team handoff
Show status on demand: current step, gates, and what taskplane is waiting on
Project native PiP, fan-out, approvals, dashboards, carousels, and governed previews with accessible fallbacks
defaultPrompt: taskplane design this feature before implementation and show me the key choices.
taskplane build this feature and ask me only for material decisions.
taskplane review this branch without changing code.
